titles.romaji: HOPE: Suiso Shakai to, Korekara no Energy no Hanashi
titles.english: ToyotaMirai : HOPE: The Hydrogen Society and Energy Sources of the Future
titles.native: HOPE～水素社会と、これからのエネルギーのはなし～

description:
A Toyota commissioned commercial explaining their hydrogen line of new cars (Toyota Mirai) while also gently explaining the purpose/reason why hydrogen technology is important for the future of the planet and how it helps reduce environmental issues.

Note: An English version of this advertisement titled "ToyotaMirai : HOPE: The Hydrogen Society and Energy Sources of the Future" was uploaded on the Toyota Global YouTube channel on Apr 28, 2015.
